title: Chapter 409 Precarious
content:
Chapter 409 Precarious

The four provinces in the eastern part of the imperial court were completely lost, and the rebels were powerful, gradually intending to sweep across the whole country.

This news quickly passed through the provincial capitals around the area controlled by Zhong Yu, and spread to the entire Ming Dynasty.

The court was shocked and the people panicked.

For the long-term peace and stability of the Ming Dynasty, it has been nearly 500 years, and there has never been such a large-scale rebellion.

Now that such a group of traitors suddenly appeared, how could the court not be shocked and angry.

Since ancient times, a large-scale rebellion in a dynasty, and the trend of sweeping across the country, usually indicates that the dynasty has gradually come to an end.

And now, Zhong Yu, the rebel who captured the four provinces, appeared in the Ming Dynasty. Wouldn't he tell the subjects of the entire Ming Dynasty that my Ming Dynasty is no longer good, and it's time for all ambitious people to rebel?

No, this kind of thing will never be allowed to happen.

"General Gao, I will give you an army of 200,000, and I will surely succeed in no time. I will put down the rebels and wipe out the rebellion." Said.

"The final general will not disgrace his life, and he will capture the head of the traitor in front of the hall as a thank you for the emperor's kindness." General Gao knelt down on one knee, and replied with a solemn face.

Beside him, two rows of hundreds of court ministers were looking at him with envy, jealousy, implicit expectation, or other expressions.

Glory, at this moment, belongs to him.

This time, in order to deal with the increasingly powerful rebels, that is, Zhong Yu, who occupied the four provinces in the eastern part of the Ming Dynasty and even assumed the title of emperor.

The Ming emperor not only mobilized all the soldiers and horses he could mobilize under his command, a total of 100,000 soldiers. Also recruited new troops from the people, another 100,000 people.

Based on this, the army of rebellion was formed this time, and the last essence of the 200,000 Ming Dynasty was handed over to Gao Tuilu, who is known as the God of War, and he was called General Dingyuan.

Under the curious, fearful and astonishing eyes of countless people in the capital, the rebellious army marched out, slowly left the east gate, and began its endless journey.

Three days later, the army had only traveled two hundred miles, when suddenly a fast horse galloped towards the capital from behind, and a red dragon flag was displayed on the knight, which was a signal representing an urgent military situation, and the surrounding troops did not dare to stop them, and retreated .

"Who is that? Did something happen to the capital among these three?" Gao Tuilu frowned as he looked at the galloping knight. But I thought of the three princes in the capital fighting for the throne. Could it be that someone couldn't wait and wanted to start a mutiny?

Gao Tuilu was contemplating when the knight had already approached.

"Report, the emperor's urgent order!" The knight shouted loudly.

Hearing this, Gao Tuilu quickly got off his horse and knelt down on one knee to greet him.

"Decree, General Dingyuan immediately leads the army back to the division, and goes to the northern border to defend against the enemy. The order arrives immediately, and there must be no delay." The knight immediately spoke out the order without delay.

Back to the teacher, also drove to northern Xinjiang.

Thinking of these two orders, Gao Tuilu couldn't help but feel puzzled.

"This envoy, why do you want to go back? Didn't the army go to quell the chaos according to the established plan?" Since he couldn't figure it out, Gao Tuilu asked directly. If there is no legitimate reason, it is not a joke to accept random life.

"General Gao, it's not that the emperor doesn't want to put down the thieves, but that in the early hours of this morning, there was a sudden rush of military news from thousands of miles away in northern Xinjiang. In Liaodong Province, it is possible to attack the imperial city at any time, and the general has to be called back to drive back the enemy." The knight gave a wry smile, and told the shocking news.

"What? The northern line of defense has been breached, and it's almost reaching the capital." Gao Tuilu was also taken aback when he heard this, and said in horror.

Although I have some understanding of the disadvantaged situation in the northern part of the empire, after all, there is an army of 300,000 in the empire, and the Jin Empire on the opposite side is only 500,000 troops. How can it be so easy to break through the defense line.

After all, the advantage of defense is far greater than that of offense. It is extremely difficult for Da Jin to break through the long-running front of the Ming Empire without more than double the number of people.

"Yeah, we didn't expect it either, but the situation is indeed the case. The general should return to the army quickly, so as not to change things if it is too late." The knight was also distressed. As the imperial guard of the imperial court, he also had a certain status in front of the emperor. Destiny can be said to be bound together with Daming, one prospers all prospers one loses all ones loses, they have long been indistinguishable from each other.

Today's situation in Daming is so precarious, for these stakeholders, it can be said that they feel empathy.

"Alas! The state affairs are difficult. I will go back to the army, and the envoy will go back first to report." Gao Tuilu sighed, feeling confused about the precarious situation in Daming.

A moment later, the 200,000 troops received an order that made them dizzy, and the whole army returned to the imperial capital.

Two days later, under the emergency march, the army quickly returned to Kyoto, and before they had time to rest, the emperor's order came again.

The army drove to Liaodong Province in the north, where it resisted the aggression of the Great Jin Dynasty on the spot, and waited for an opportunity to retreat from the enemy and regain lost ground.

Not long after this, all the provinces, prefectures and counties of the Ming Dynasty also knew the news of the defeat in the war in the northern part of the empire and the large-scale invasion of the Jin Dynasty, which shocked the whole country.

Many subjects in all parts of Ming Dynasty became terrified, for fear that they would not know when the war would burn to their side, and they would also live a life full of war.

After all, no matter how you look at it, there are large-scale rebels inside, powerful foreign enemies invade outside, the entire bureaucratic system is rampant with corrupt officials, and the emperor seems to be obsessed with practicing longevity and a bit fatuous. It is a scene of the end of the dynasty.

And often accompanied by such signs, it symbolizes that a long-established empire is about to perish.

What is about to kick off will be decades of war until the owner of this land is determined again.

When the northern part of the Ming Dynasty was invaded, the news that the capital was in jeopardy spread all over the place. As Zhong Yu, who was always paying attention to the situation of the Ming Dynasty, and sent spies everywhere to spy on the news, he naturally got this extremely important news.

For Zhong Yu, this news is extremely crucial and important, and will determine his future strategic direction.

The energy of the Ming Dynasty once again got Da Jin involved, and in the face of the crisis of national subjugation, the Ming court might no longer have the slightest spare power to suppress itself as a traitor.

Those large armies were not valued by Zhong Yu very much, no matter how many they came, he would still be able to fight with the same amount.

What really troubled him was the large number of powerhouses above Tier 6 and Zhong Yu with a shallow background, but there was no way to pull out so many people at once, and it took time to cultivate them.

But now this last worry has disappeared because of Da Jin's intervention.

After all, as an empire that also stands on this continent, the level of masters of Da Jin is not weaker than that of Ming.

Especially now that it is possible to completely destroy Daming and annex its land.

The Great Jin Dynasty will not hold back at all, presumably his camp of masters has all moved to the front line, ready to defeat Da Ming in one fell swoop!
